preconditions.description: The length of the input text is no more than 10000 characters.
The text begins and ends with a Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isspace() or c in '.,!?') for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output text consists of lowercase Latin letters, spaces, and punctuation marks (dot, comma, exclamation mark, and question mark).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == ' ' or stdout[i].isalpha() for i in range(len(stdout)) if stdout[i] in '.,!?')
postconditions.description: There are no spaces before each punctuation mark.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == ' ' or stdout[i+1].isalpha() for i in range(len(stdout)-1) if stdout[i] in '.,!?')
postconditions.description: There is exactly one space after each punctuation mark.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] != ' ' or stdout[i+1] != ' ' for i in range(len(stdout)-1))
postconditions.description: There are no consecutive spaces in the output text.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] != ' ' or stdout[i-1].isalpha() or stdout[i-1] in '.,!?' for i in range(1, len(stdout)))
postconditions.description: If there is no punctuation mark between two words, then they are separated by exactly one space.
